title: Sr.Software Engineer (iOS) | 4+ Years | Ahmedabad Candidates
description:
About the Company : Vagaro is a global leader in cloud\-based business management software, serving the salon, spa, beauty, fitness, and wellness industries. Our platform enables businesses to manage scheduling, payments, marketing, and operations from one centralized system.
 



  





 We are a rapidly growing, product\-led company transforming how wellness businesses operate and connect with their customers. 
 



  





**Why Join us:** 



* 5\-day work week \& flexible schedule
* Fun Fridays, Tech sessions \& cultural events
* Learning resources \& gaming zones
* Annual bonus \& recognition programs
* Leave encashment \& maternity benefits
* 15 Paid Leaves \+ 11 Holidays
* Comprehensive family medical insurance



  





 💼 Role: Sr. Software Engineer (iOS)
 



 📍 Location: Ahmedabad (Work from Office)
 



  🎓 Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field 
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a Sr. Software Engineer (iOS) who builds with AI, not just alongside it. If you have genuinely integrated AI tools like Claude, OpenAI Codex, and GitHub Copilot into your daily coding workflow and can architect and ship production\-grade iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit, we want to talk.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own end\-to\-end architecture of significant iOS features or modules; make informed build vs. buy decisions.
* Drive app performance \- launch time, memory, battery \- with profiling\-backed, measurable improvements.
* Lead technical design reviews, mentor SDE 2 engineers \& elevate team engineering standards.
* Establish coding conventions, modularisation strategy \& release engineering practices for the iOS codebase.
* Own App Store release process end\-to\-end; manage provisioning, review escalations \& launch readiness.
* Partner with product and design to define technical feasibility, scope, \& platform constraints.
* Break down complex epics into actionable milestones; align cross\-functional delivery timelines.



  





 AI\-FIRST 
 


* Champion Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI Codex, and GitHub Copilot adoption across the iOS team; define team\-wide AI development workflow standards.
* Architect on\-device AI pipelines using Core ML and Apple Intelligence APIs; evaluate model hosting, compression, and inference strategy.
* Define telemetry and evaluation strategy for AI features in production — accuracy, latency, and engagement metrics.
* Enforce responsible AI standards — on\-device inference preference, privacy\-preserving design, and App Review compliance for AI features.



  





 AI coding tools: Claude (Anthropic)  ·  OpenAI Codex  ·  GitHub Copilot  ·  Core ML / Apple Intelligence 
 



 SKILLS \& TOOLS : Swift / Obj\-C · SwiftUI / UIKit · Combine / async\-await · Clean Arch / TCA · Modularisation · CI/CD · Xcode · Core ML / Create ML · Apple Intelligence APIs · LLM API design 
 



  





 This is your opportunity to showcase what you can do, share your ideas, and get to know the people and culture behind Vagaro.

title: MERN Stack Intern
description:
**Company Description** 




 Brainy Neurals is a leading Artificial Intelligence development company based in Ahmedabad, India, transforming how businesses operate since 2023\. The company builds end\-to\-end AI solutions, including computer vision for quality and safety, custom chatbots for customer interactions, and edge AI models that run in real time on devices without relying on the cloud. With deep expertise in NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Intel technologies, and modern AI frameworks, Brainy Neurals delivers tailored solutions that drive measurable business growth. The team works across domains such as custom AI product development, vision analytics, data analytics, robotics, and business automation using AI. Brainy Neurals is committed to ongoing research and development, ensuring clients benefit from the most advanced and efficient AI capabilities available.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a remote, contract MERN Stack Intern role focused on supporting AI\-driven web application development. Day\-to\-day tasks include assisting in building and maintaining web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js, implementing RESTful APIs, and integrating front\-end interfaces with back\-end services. The intern will collaborate with senior developers and AI engineers to connect web applications with AI models, participate in code reviews, and help troubleshoot and fix bugs. Responsibilities also include writing clean, documented code, contributing to basic UI/UX improvements, and following best practices for performance, security, and scalability. The intern will be expected to learn quickly, take feedback constructively, and communicate progress regularly with the distributed team.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess core MERN skills, including basic experience with MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.
* Candidates should possess front\-end development skills such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and familiarity with responsive design and component\-based architecture.
* Candidates should possess back\-end and API skills, including RESTful API development, JSON handling, and integration with databases.
* Candidates should possess software development fundamentals such as version control (Git), debugging, testing basics, and understanding of secure coding practices.
* Candidates should possess problem\-solving and collaboration skills, including the ability to read documentation, learn new tools quickly, and work effectively in a remote, cross\-functional team.
* Relevant academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) is beneficial.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, cloud or edge deployment, or interest in building AI\-enabled applications is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to manage time and tasks in a remote setup are expected.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
We are looking for a skilled
 **Mobile App Developer** 
 with 3–5 years of experience to lead the development of our high\-performance
 **customer\-facing fintech mobile application** 
 . In this role, you will own the mobile ecosystem, converting complex financial workflows into sleek, native\-performing Android and iOS experiences using
 **Flutter** 
 . You will work closely with our backend teams to integrate high\-security APIs and ensure a seamless transactional experience for our users.
 



  





**🚀 Key Responsibilities** 



* **Complex App Architecture:** 
 Design, build, and maintain high\-fidelity, complex mobile applications from scratch using Flutter.
* **Robust API Integration:** 
 Seamlessly integrate complex backend APIs (Node.js/NestJS/Laravel) for real\-time data syncing, user authentication, and transaction handling.
* **Performance Optimization:** 
 Ensure smooth 60fps performance, minimize app size, manage offline data storage, and optimize rendering loops for complex UI/UX designs.
* **Fintech Security:** 
 Implement secure mobile practices including biometric authentication (FaceID/Fingerprint), secure storage for local keys, SSL pinning, and data encryption.
* **State Management:** 
 Utilize structured architectural patterns (like BLoC, Riverpod, or Provider) to handle deep and state\-heavy customer workflows.
* **App Store Deployment:** 
 Manage the complete end\-to\-end publishing pipeline for both Google Play Store and Apple App Store, handling code signing, provisioning profiles, and beta testing tools (TestFlight).



  





**🛠️ Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* **Flutter Mastery:** 
 3\+ years of professional experience building and delivering production\-ready, feature\-rich mobile apps using Flutter \& Dart.
* **Advanced API Consumption:** 
 Deep expertise in handling complex RESTful or GraphQL endpoints, handling network caching, custom interceptors, and web sockets.
* **UI/UX Precision:** 
 Exceptional ability to translate Figma designs into pixel\-perfect, responsive responsive layouts across various screen sizes.
* **Native Bridge Knowledge:** 
 Basic understanding of native platforms (Android/Kotlin/Java or iOS/Swift) to write platform\-specific code via MethodChannels when necessary.
* **DevOps \& Tools:** 
 Experience with Git, mobile analytics (Firebase, Mixpanel), crash reporting tools (Crashlytics), and CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps.
